accepted_findings: Realized nonoverlap train-gain accounting is coherent under the bound native semantics.
The implemented fairness test is thresholded floating-point descent, not symbolic exact descent.
Fallback steps invalidate an unqualified monotonic or always-constrained fairness claim.
exact_train is a no-descent-constraint, minmax-development-tiebroken exact-train-gain control, not a development-blind control.
Raw adjacency frequency defines eligibility while corrected nonoverlap gain defines selection.
Internal assert-based verification was insufficient for a strong verification claim.
All outcomes remain exposed development diagnostics and do not establish independent confirmation or general fairness.
unresolved_scope: Replay validates the selected sequence but does not independently enumerate and prove global selector optimality for every unselected pair.
No new output is an unexposed confirmation set.
The experiment is bilingual and does not establish multilingual or third-language robustness.
